response.evidence: Under 'Connecting to Firestore database > Prerequisites': "An Astro project initialized with Firebase as described in the Initializing Firebase in Astro section. A Firebase project with a Firestore database."
response.rationale: The Prerequisites for the Firestore section explicitly require an Astro project already initialized with Firebase and a Firebase project that has a Firestore database before connecting to the database.
